text:
Lior Beres I dont think its your business to tell me who or what to align myself with. You may tell me your opinion and try to convince me with pleasure. But your “ordering” me what to do is the psychological paradox that is always a tell - it seems act in a similar way to the people you are fighting against.

I am not aligned with anyone and chose to align myself with justice. I also take into consideration that there are many who take advantage of the situation. There are not good and bad tourists but there ARE genuine tourists and those that are not.

Family members visiting for sure should be freely allowed to come and visit according to law without hinderance - that is for sure.

Good luck with your work and policy change but refining your articulation might land a bit better if it it was more sophisticated.

All the best to you!
